title: Freddie Slater to make F1 weekend debut with FP1 outings for Audi in Mexico City and Sao Paulo
paragraphs: Audi Development Driver Freddie Slater will get his first taste of Formula 1 race weekend action when he drives for Audi in FP1 in Mexico City and Sao Paulo. The 18-year-old became the first driver to be signed to the German manufacturer's programme earlier this year and dovetailed his duties with a campaign in F3 where he finished runner up with Trident Motorsport. He'll step up to F2 next season
